titulo: Quiz — The dish you were never going to order
introPt: A traveller stops ordering the one item they recognise.

dialogo.es: Oggi abbiamo i carciofi. Li facciamo alla giudia.
dialogo.pt: Today we have artichokes. We do them Jewish-style.
Then I'll have that, I trust you.

dialogo.es: Un quarto di vino della casa, rosso.
dialogo.pt: A quarter litre of house wine, red.

perguntas.pergunta: What do the two words mi fido do?
opcoes: Signal you will not be a difficult table — and the quality reflects it
perguntas.explica: The first sentence gets a recommendation; the second gets the good one.

perguntas.pergunta: Must you order all five courses?
opcoes: No — a primo and a contorno is a normal meal
perguntas.explica: Say which courses you want so the rest does not arrive.

perguntas.pergunta: A fixed multilingual menu with photographs signals:
opcoes: Food designed around never seeing you again
perguntas.explica: That is the opposite of the incentive you want.

opcoes: Usually the local wine the place actually drinks
perguntas.explica: Often the better call than the cheapest bottle.

perguntas.pergunta: The waiter names one dish with no alternatives. That means:
opcoes: There is a right answer today
perguntas.explica: A long list of options is the more commercial response.
